title: Amos Bible Quiz - Chapter 8
description: Ten questions on Amos 8: the basket of summer fruit, the traders who cheat the poor, and the famine of hearing Yahweh's words.

questions.text: What did the Lord Yahweh show Amos at the start of this chapter?
questions.explanation: The Lord Yahweh showed Amos a basket of summer fruit.

answers.text: A plumb line by a wall
A basket of dry bread
A basket of summer fruit
A flock of grazing sheep

questions.text: What did Yahweh say after Amos said what he saw?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said that the end had come on his people Israel, and that he would not pass by them any more.

answers.text: The end has come on my people Israel
The land will rest for seven years
My people will be gathered again
I will pass by them once more

questions.text: What do the traders in verse 5 do with the ephah and the shekel?
questions.explanation: They make the ephah small and the shekel large, dealing falsely with balances of deceit.

answers.text: They make the ephah large and the shekel small
They weigh out grain and silver honestly
They hand the ephah and shekel to the priests
They make the ephah small and the shekel large

questions.text: For what do they say they will buy the needy?
questions.explanation: They plan to buy the poor for silver and the needy for a pair of sandals, and to sell the sweepings with the wheat.

answers.text: For a field of grain
For a pair of sandals
For a jar of oil
For a yoke of oxen

questions.text: By what has Yahweh sworn that he will never forget their works?
questions.explanation: Yahweh has sworn by the pride of Jacob that he will never forget any of their works.

answers.text: By the heavens above
By his own right hand
By the pride of Jacob
By the hills of Zion

questions.text: What will Yahweh do to the sun in that day?
questions.explanation: The Lord Yahweh says he will cause the sun to go down at noon and will darken the earth in the clear day.

answers.text: He will hold it still at evening
He will make it shine at midnight
He will hide it behind the sea
He will make it go down at noon

questions.text: What kind of famine does Yahweh say he will send in the land?
questions.explanation: He will send a famine that is not of bread and not a thirst for water, but of hearing Yahweh's words.

answers.text: A famine of bread and water
A famine of hearing Yahweh's words
A famine of wine and oil
A famine of seed for sowing

questions.text: What happens to those who run back and forth to seek Yahweh's word?
questions.explanation: They wander from sea to sea and from the north to the east to seek Yahweh's word, and they will not find it.

answers.text: They will not find it
They will find it in Zion
They will hear it from kings
They will read it in Samaria

questions.text: Who will faint for thirst in that day?
questions.explanation: In that day the beautiful virgins and the young men will faint for thirst.

answers.text: The priests and the elders of the land
The kings and the princes of Israel
The beautiful virgins and the young men
The shepherds and the keepers of flocks

questions.text: What will happen to those who swear by the sin of Samaria?
questions.explanation: Those who swear by the sin of Samaria will fall and never rise up again.

answers.text: They will fall and never rise up again
They will be carried off to Dan
They will be forgiven in that day
They will be left alone in the land
